title: Usage-based Billing
seo: Usage-based billing for seats, credits and metered plans
meta: Charge by seats, usage or credits, with metering, limits and clear bills. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Pay-for-what-you-use billing, built into your product
overview: Some products are fairer when customers pay for what they use. We set up per-seat pricing, metered usage such as API calls or exports, or a credit balance that is topped up and spent. We record usage events from your app, send them to your billing provider, show customers a live meter, and make sure invoices explain the number clearly so a surprise bill never happens.

faq: How do you make sure usage is counted correctly?
Each event carries a unique ID so repeats are ignored, and we compare totals against your own data in a test month. You see the check before launch.
Can customers see what they will be charged?
Yes. We show a live usage meter and an estimate for the current period. We also write the invoice lines so the amount is easy to understand.
Stripe and Paddle support usage in different ways. We check which fits your model first and tell you if a limit would affect your plan before building anything.
Is this suitable for a product that is not live yet?
Yes. We build and test using the provider's test mode and sample events, so you can see full bills before a single real customer is charged.
